claim_ceiling: finite reversible binary-ring QCA diagnostic only. Computes transition trajectories, cycle/absorbing-set structure, explicit inverse reversibility, and a GNVW-style directional index from conjugated coordinate-observable support. No infinite-system GNVW theorem, no canonical QCA classification, no promotion.

object_under_test.brickwork_boundary: finite-depth local controls use U = U_odd o U_even with even bonds [[0,1],[2,3],[4,5]] and odd bonds [[1,2],[3,4],[5,0]]
object_under_test.shift_controls: right_shift and left_shift are reversible finite local SWAP-runner controls on the same finite ring; their index is measured from conjugated support of the resulting transition table, not from the rule label
object_under_test.oriented_cut: 2|3, with left side [0,1,2] and right side [3,4,5]

right_shift.transition: apply adjacent SWAP blocks [[4,5],[3,4],[2,3],[1,2],[0,1]], which rotates cell contents right by one on this finite ring

left_shift.transition: apply adjacent SWAP blocks [[0,1],[1,2],[2,3],[3,4],[4,5]], which rotates cell contents left by one on this finite ring

finite_depth_local_circuit.transition: U_even swaps even bonds, then U_odd swaps odd bonds

equivalence_relation: tau ~_support tau' iff the conjugated coordinate-observable support-flow rank difference across the oriented cut 2|3 is equal: ind_q(tau)=r_R(tau)-r_L(tau)=r_R(tau')-r_L(tau'). The trajectory digest is separate: tau ~_cycle tau' iff their finite transition graph cycle-length multisets match.

gnvw_style_index_definition.conjugation: e_i -> e_i o F^{-1}; support is computed by exhaustive finite differences of F^{-1}(y)_i with respect to output cells y_j
gnvw_style_index_definition.right_rank: GF(2) rank of restricted support rows for source cell 2 on right cells [3,4,5]
gnvw_style_index_definition.left_rank: GF(2) rank of restricted support rows for source cell 3 on left cells [0,1,2]
gnvw_style_index_definition.index_units_log_q: r_R - r_L for q=2. This is a finite diagnostic analogue, not a theorem-level GNVW invariant.

genuine_could_fail_discriminators: finite-depth local brickwork circuit -> computed index 0
every rule's explicit inverse composes both ways to identity on all 2^6 states
absorbing sets are read from the transition graph cycles, not assumed from reversibility

engines.exact: stdlib exhaustive transition-table and finite-difference support leg
engines.jax: JAX x64 vectorized transition-table, inverse, dependency, cycle-summary mirror; does not read exact results
